title: Prove sharp E8 A2 rank-five joint incidence 20
body:
## Summary

```diff
 Full E8 A2 projective fiber A, arbitrary ambient binary rank<=5 support V
- sufficient total-support + singleton-support bound: 21
+ sharp bound: |R intersect V| + |A intersect V| <=20
```

Add `research/e8-a2-joint-incidence20/`. The seven-space spanned by each large fiber has a leading-one affine six-space with positive Gauss sum 8. A rank-five support inside it contains at most ten roots. Outside it, at most eight singleton labels combine with the global twelve-root cap. A literal ten-root support attains 20 on full E8. Fixed P112 inherits the upper bound.

This replaces the incidence 21 dependency used by PR3257. Its proof recalls the required global 12 argument of PR3269 and has no pending executable or Git-object dependency. Normalization of arbitrary code planes, shortening thresholds, actual callers, full C5, native suppliers and kappa remain separate. The selected result is unchanged.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the ten-singleton closure argument in PR3257 supplied 21 and left the nine-singleton branch at 12+9.
  **After:** the affine six-space restriction bounds every fiber-contained rank-five support by 10. The outside-span case has at most 8 singleton sites. Both give 20, with exact equality evidence.
- All 1,120 A2 planes and 3,360 distinct large fibers are checked, including polar nondegeneracy and the positive sign. The canonical 2,667-space census and a separate dense/norm reconstruction of 80,730 five-label subsets agree on 216 equality closures.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, seven source-boundary and six hypothesis/capacity control groups, Ruff and source compilation pass. A designated read-only internal peer check found no blocker after inspecting the proof, code, source binding and exact export. Its fresh read-only Git-free export passed all three commands under optimized CPython 3.14. Exact hashes and unrun limits are in REVIEW.json.
- All 14 final committed package/input byte comparisons and official export integrity pass. The exact committed scientific export also passed all three commands under optimized CPython 3.13.16. These are finite exact checks supporting a written proof, not proof-kernel or independent human approval. Historical global censuses, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker are unrun.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/e8-a2-joint-incidence20
```

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19003772). Exact predecessor proof paths, commits and hashes are in PREDECESSORS.json. Credit Nick Petalas/PR3257/3269, David Arias's quadratic-model work, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 and the retained E8/P112 lineage including joaqcoo. Open next questions and source pins are included. The simultaneous uniform-cut47, mixed-cut39 and caller reconciliation contributions have distinct predicates and are not claimed here.

Submission overlap covers 324 open PRs and 2,116 Discussion records with complete pagination through 2026-10-17T20:28:08Z. All fifteen prior-batch heads remain open and unchanged. Closed, arbitrary-diff and unpublished work are not exhaustively covered. Canonical main was refetched unchanged before submission.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One opt-in research package. Frozen inputs, shared tools and selected-frontier records are unchanged. The theorem concerns the declared leading-one root labels. Other physical encodings need their own rank-preserving binding.
